# Binding portfolio engineering rule

Load `docs/engineering/IRON-ENG-001.md` and `AGENTS.md` before each build or review. For changed functionality, require exact-revision requirement traceability, data semantics, authorization/tenant isolation, real persistence and restart tests, complete recipient workflows, exercised failure/recovery, browser acceptance, independent review, matching documents and post-deploy verification. Document and independently review scoped non-applicability; missing implementation is not non-applicability.

Cursor and Bugbot are not required. Internal reproducible audits, GitHub and Vercel may supply equivalent evidence; neutral, skipped, quota-limited, failed, pending or stale-revision results do not pass. A green CI badge, published URL or supplied receipt label is not independently verified real-world behavior.

Do not merge around material gaps or bypass a user hold. Carry version/digest and acceptance obligations to every delegate. Report implementation, tests, review, merge, deployment, delivery and measured outcome separately.
